extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals and prospective members (India, Kolkata chapter)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational-level standards and values that guide professional public relations practice and communications (e.g., press releases, member conduct, events) promoted by the PRSI Kolkata Chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real (Authenticity & Transparency)
rubrics_metrics.description: We commit to authenticity and transparency, ensuring that our communications and interactions are genuine and grounded in truth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications (including press releases) should be truthful, clear, and transparent; avoid misleading claims and ensure factual accuracy and openness about intent and sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant (Timely & Pertinent Insights)
rubrics_metrics.description: We stay attuned to the evolving needs of the industry, providing timel and pertinent insights that drive effective and impactful communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information should be timely and tailored to current industry needs and audience concerns; content should prioritize relevance and practical value for stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resourceful (Creativity & Strategic Thinking)
rubrics_metrics.description: We leverage creativity and strategic thinking to overcome challenges and deliver innovative solutions, maximizing value for our members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use creative angles and strategic framing in messaging to solve communication challenges and make releases/news items stand out while serving organizational goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive Communication
rubrics_metrics.description: To advance public relations as a strategic profession by fostering proactive communication...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anticipate stakeholder information needs and address issues proactively rather than reactively; plan communications as part of broader strategic management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: To advance public relations as a strategic profession by fostering ... ethical practices ... across industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to professional ethics in all communications — honesty, accountability, respect for privacy and consent, and avoidance of deceptive tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Development
rubrics_metrics.description: To advance public relations as a strategic profession by fostering ... professional development across industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support continuous learning and skill development (e.g., training, events, knowledge sharing) to maintain standards of practice and improve the quality of outputs like press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: PRSI, Kolkata Chapter fosters a collaborative environment where members share innovative strategies and best practices across industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage peer exchange, case studies, and sharing of best practices to raise the overall standard of PR work; use collaboration to refine messaging and validate approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-sector Dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: The chapter promotes professional development & facilitates cross-sector dialogue to enhance PR’s impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage stakeholders across public, private, and community sectors to ensure communications consider multiple perspectives and increase societal impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancing PR Nationwide / Societal Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: PRSI, Kolkata Chapter drives the growth of the PR profession across India, shaping both organizational success and societal outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should consider broader organizational and societal consequences; aim for messaging that furthers both business objectives and positive social outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full Professional Membership Requirements (procedural standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals are required to meet specific criteria for full professional membership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership implies meeting specified professional standards and qualifications (page references the existence of criteria though specifics are not listed); verify eligibility before representing the chapter or using chapter credentials in communications.
